description: Opt-out dengan panduan untuk SearchPeopleFree. Seseorang mengikuti langkah-langkah pada daftar periksa; OpenOptOut menyediakan alamat email sekali pakai dan mengeklik tautan konfirmasi.
instructions: Search searchpeoplefree.com by name, phone number, address and email; people are often listed more than once. For each record, use searchpeoplefree.com/opt-out, giving {contact_email} as the email address. Kemudian tekan "Saya sudah melakukan ini".
